title: 5D resolution profile
description: A digest-pinned resolution profile (spec/SPEC.md §16, build list item 6; fields clause_cue_saturation/match_blend_weights added by the fix round, 2026-10-02, owner-approved integration step — spec/SPEC.md §8a/§19; relational_suppression_scale added 2026-10-03, the s in §8a's relational_effective down-weighting formula). Mirrors five_d_nd/profile.py's profile_violations() field table exactly: 'profile_id' is the only REQUIRED field; every other field is OPTIONAL (absent means the module's own DEFAULTS), but MUST have the declared type when present. 'additionalProperties: false' (fix round item 7): an unknown field (e.g. a typo like "K") is now REJECTED here too, matching five_d_nd.profile.KNOWN_FIELDS exactly — a typo must not silently leave a default in place. This schema cannot express the 'd_blend_weights.links + d_blend_weights.nesting must be strictly positive' / 'match_blend_weights.term + match_blend_weights.structural must be strictly positive' cross-field rules — that is code-only, the same category of gap §9's own id/namespace cross-field checks already document.
